phase-plan.purpose: Implement the dungeon-pressure pillar from the gameplay design by wiring boss spawn cadence to the authored spawn table, restoring temporary hostility after authored tick windows, and surfacing time-pressure state to the playable HUD.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: spawn countdown state, boss-adjacent hostile spawns using authored caps and weighted archetypes, temporary hostility decay, stronger in-shell warning language, shell/map countdown support, and planning/docs sync. Out of scope for this slice: the deeper authored room-entry interaction pillar and full mana-resource convergence.

file.description: Own the reusable countdown, boss-spawn selection, and hostility-decay helpers.
Consume pressure helpers, spawn hostiles on authored cadence, and expose countdown state through runtime status.
Escalate theft into temporary hostility so the decay system has real runtime behavior to resolve.
Authored spawn cadence and caps remain the source of truth for boss pressure.
Map/HUD detail should expose boss-spawn countdown and temporary hostility readouts.
The floor shell should surface pressure warnings and show the correct room-feature actions in the right-side panel.
Shared navigation helpers now provide pressure-warning lines and room narrative context for the shell.
Document where pressure/countdown/hostility systems now live and what remains for presentation polish.

task.description: Replace unconditional hostile spawning with authored spawn-table cadence, caps, and weighted archetype selection.
Add temporary hostility state with authored tick decay and restore entities to their base faction when the timer expires.
Expose boss-spawn countdown and hostility state through engine status and KAPLAY map/HUD readouts.
Polish pressure presentation with stronger in-shell warning language and additional authored/event-driven pressure surfacing where needed.

decision.summary: Pressure is owned by engine runtime state and authored spawn-table data, not by a KAPLAY-only timer.
decision.impact: Boss cadence, hostility decay, and countdown readouts now survive save/snapshot flow and can be shared across future consumers.

decision.summary: Temporary hostility is modeled as a reversible faction override with a base-faction restore point.
decision.impact: The runtime can escalate NPC reactions now without permanently mutating identity/occupation state, which keeps authored NPC roles intact.

decision.summary: Pressure warnings should ride the same bottom room-info shell the player already reads, not a separate debug overlay.
decision.impact: Boss cadence and hostile-floor state now present as part of the normal room loop, which keeps the map-first UI coherent while raising threat visibility.
